savedQuery.title: Request processing comparison
savedQuery.text: SELECT r.order_id AS pair_member,e.event_id AS observed_event,a.attempt_id AS observed_attempt,e.kind AS observed_kind,e.sequence AS observed_sequence,e.occurred_at AS observed_time,e.clock_domain AS observed_clock,e.precision_ms AS observed_precision,CASE WHEN e.kind='routing-blocked' THEN 'fail' ELSE 'pass' END AS observed_status,CASE WHEN (e.kind='request-created' OR e.kind='replay-started') AND e.sequence=1 AND e.occurred_at=a.started_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS observed_start,a.config_revision,e.artifact,e.artifact_sha256,e.byte_start,e.byte_end,w.generation AS source_generation,'events' AS source_collection,e.event_id AS source_record_key,NULL AS evidence_ref FROM requests r JOIN attempts a ON a.request_id=r.request_id JOIN events e ON e.attempt_id=a.attempt_id CROSS JOIN workspace_state w WHERE r.order_id=@order_id OR r.order_id=@comparison_order_id ORDER BY r.order_id,a.attempt_no,e.sequence
